items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: your grandmother, Mom Ollie, kept you a lot. You stayed with her.

ctx.x: She went to India... Well, I think so...it was later.
Some of it before, because your grandmother, Mom Ollie, kept you a lot. You stayed with her. Originally on the island, it was your grandparents’ house they lived in.
